definitions.explanation: digging, boring, or drilling into the ground, typically for construction, mining, or extracting resources like oil and gas

examples.japanese: {井戸|いど}を{掘削|くっさく}する。
トンネル{掘削|くっさく}{工事|こうじ}が{始|はじ}まった。
{油田|ゆでん}の{掘削|くっさく}は{莫大|ばくだい}な{費用|ひよう}がかかる。
examples.english: Oil field drilling costs an enormous amount.

examples.japanese: {掘削|くっさく}{機|き}を{使|つか}って{地下|ちか}を{掘|ほ}り{進|すす}める。
examples.english: They dig underground using excavation equipment.

notes:
{掘削|くっさく} refers to drilling or excavating into the ground, commonly used in construction, tunneling, and resource extraction contexts.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {掘|くつ} (dig)
- {削|さく} (shave, scrape, cut)

USAGE:
- {掘削|くっさく}する (to drill, to excavate - suru verb)
- {掘削|くっさく}{機|き} (drilling/excavation machine)
- {掘削|くっさく}{工事|こうじ} (excavation work)

COMMON APPLICATIONS:
- {井戸|いど}の{掘削|くっさく} (well drilling)
- {油田|ゆでん}{掘削|くっさく} (oil field drilling)
- トンネル{掘削|くっさく} (tunnel excavation)
- {地盤|じばん}{掘削|くっさく} (ground excavation)

TECHNICAL EQUIPMENT:
- {掘削|くっさく}{機|き} (drilling machine)
- {掘削|くっさく}リグ (drilling rig)
- シールド{掘削|くっさく}{機|き} (shield tunneling machine)

CONTRAST:
- {発掘|はっくつ} - archaeological excavation/discovery
- {採掘|さいくつ} - mining for resources
- {掘削|くっさく} - drilling/boring (mechanical excavation)

RELATED TERMS:
- {発掘|はっくつ} (excavation - archaeological)
- {採掘|さいくつ} (mining, extraction)
- {穿孔|せんこう} (boring, drilling)
- {掘|ほ}る (to dig - basic verb)
